unresolved_candidates.relationship: Proposed identification of David’s cave occasion
unresolved_candidates.rationale: The psalm heading names a cave but no location or pursuer. The account in 1 Samuel records David in the En-gedi cave and also records the Adullam cave in 22:1. This target does not uniquely establish the heading’s occasion.
